steps.title: Install Blender (optional)
steps.detail: Unify offers this only when it can't find Blender. Tick it when you install the pack and Unify installs the latest Blender before it sets up the add-on. Skip it if you run Blender from somewhere else (a portable copy, for example).

steps.title: Install the Blender add-on
steps.detail: Unify finds Blender, installs the Unify Bridge add-on and turns it on. If Blender isn't found, install it by hand: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > the menu at the top right > Install from Disk..., pick the file below, then tick Unify Bridge.

steps.title: Restart Blender
steps.detail: Close and reopen any Blender windows. They connect to Unify by themselves once the add-on is on.
